title: H3191 (122nd General Assembly): Penalties for offense involving unlawful carrying of handguns

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2016-12-15; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess122_2017-2018/prever/3191_20161215.htm (LegiScan doc 1439442))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2016-12-15. Handgun confiscation subsection (B) is unchanged except 'under' struck and 'pursuant to' added.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 16-23-50): (A)(1) A person, including a dealer, who violates the provisions of this article, except Section 16-23-20, is guilty of a felony and, upon conviction, for a: (a) first offense, must be fined not more than two thousand dollars or imprisoned not more than five years, or both; (b) second offense, must be fined not more than five thousand dollars or imprisoned not less than one year nor more than five years, or both; and (c) third or subsequent offense, must be fined not more than ten thousand dollars or imprisoned not less than two years nor more than ten years, or both.
Section 1 (Section 16-23-50): (2) A person who violates the provisions of Section 16-23-20 for a: (a) first offense, is guilty of a misdemeanor and, upon conviction, must be fined not more than one thousand dollars or imprisoned not more than one year, or both; (b) second offense, is guilty of a misdemeanor and, upon conviction, must be fined not more than two thousand dollars or imprisoned not more than two years, or both; (c) third or subsequent offense, is guilty of a felony and, upon conviction, must be fined not more than three thousand dollars or imprisoned not less than one year nor more than five years, or both.
